Cells (2023)

"(...) in conjunction with the theme of nature, environment, and culture, to represent techniques such as weaving fabrics with natural dyes, using macrame, miyuki, and linocuts that were all handmade, the results of a handcrafted work manage to encompass a personal process, in which an important connection is created between the work and the author. The Golden Age in Modernity (2024)

"During the 1920s in the United States, fashion and art came together perfectly to create a mind-blowing result. It was women, in particular, who embraced ideas that marked a path for history. Such is the case of what happened with Picasso, with ‘Guernica’, by what is considered the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939). Geometric shapes, emotions, and lights were an essential part of this capsule."

Shaping Denim (2024)

"Through minimalist and abstract designs, the perfection of organic lines inspired by nature is explored, especially flowers, their colorful personality, and strange shapes. Each piece is handcrafted, guaranteeing its exclusivity and quality. The use of artisanal techniques and the careful selection of sustainable materials allow the capsule to offer unique and durable garments that connect the wearer with nature and the value of handmade work. The brand is committed to sustainability, minimizing its environmental impact at every stage of the production process."
